serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Let's check out this weird package I got from the guy managing the internet cazino.
...
"We send you something special!" my ass. This looks like a bunch of ice cream related magazines. Who reads this shit?
I can't even read them as they are in Chinese(?). Did he just dump some trash onto me?
Fuck this guy...
*kick* (Anon kicked the box in anger)
*rattle rattle*
Wait a moment. Something's rattling inside of the box. Is there something inside?
Let's remove the top layer of magazines.
...
WHAT THE HELL?! There's money inside! 
That's a lot of money! I use card most of the time, so it's the first time I saw more than 2000$ at once.
Let's try to count it.
